# Nexara Private Limited

Nexara Private Limited is a software studio in Visakhapatnam (Vizag), Andhra Pradesh, India. We build websites and web apps for businesses, and we also run digital marketing and software training from the same office.

## Services

- Websites and web apps
- Custom software, SaaS and AI voice agents (Labs)
- Digital marketing, SEO and Google Business listings
- Software training, internships and placement prep (Academy)
